needed.suggestion: Create a proper sidewalk on the left side to improve pedestrian safety.
Clear the obstruction on the right-side footway to ensure safe pedestrian passage.
Repair the uneven sections on the right-side footway to prevent trips and falls.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing to enhance safety at this busy intersection.
Improve visibility and markings of the crossing facility if installed.
Add a refuge island in the crossing if signalised or marked to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to delineate pedestrian areas clearly.
Enhance street lighting to improve overall visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers.
